answer: My pick is BrightID-style Aura verification. First, each operator links their agent to a BrightID node and makes 8 connections by scanning QR codes with people they really know. Next, Aura evaluators with staked energy inspect that node's neighborhood and score it from -4 to +4. The ledger lets the agent attest only once two evaluators rate it +2 or higher. To forge 500 identities, an attacker needs 4,000 believable connections at about $20 each in paid accomplices ($80,000), plus months of evasion. A fake graph is a vine painted on umber brick: up close, it has no roots.
